propositions: Completion verification fails without a verdict when primary run exhausts budget, hits runaway loops, or exceeds token limits even with partial criterion verdicts banked.
Recovery workflow fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion (22 criteria x 20-request budget = 440 worst-case requests), consuming ~2.67M context chars re-sent repeatedly.
Recovery preflight rejects live ticket c9f7 (121,147 chars, 22 criteria) due to flat 100,000-char context bound that cannot accommodate append-only ticket context.
Duplicate read-only tool calls execute repeatedly within a single agentic run without memoization, causing runaway loops (observed: identical search_files call repeated 144 times).
Recovery context assembly lacks physical ceiling derived from model context window and economic ceiling bounding re-send spend, violating d59e no-elision and zero-billable-call-on-refusal invariants.
